newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed, gold up.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed, gold up.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were called to open mixed Thursday, with gold and silver seen higher, after some hedge fund short-covering in Europe overnight, but platinum and palladium (PGMs) were seen lower with confirmation Russian PGM exports to Japan had resumed.
COMEX August gold was called to open up $1.00 to $2.00 an ounce from Wednesday's close at $318.90, after trading between $319.00 and $322.00 in overnight ACCESS trade.

In the bullion market, spot gold was quoted $320.50/00 early, compared to the London Thursday morning fix at $319.65 and the New York close Wednesday around $318.00/50. Gold fixed at a 12 year low early Wednesday at $315.75 in London.
COMEX gold stocks fell 23,534 ounces to 858,213 ounces Wednesday, while COMEX silver stocks fell 1,200,063 ounces to 181,276,778 ounces.
COMEX September silver was seen opening up 1.00 to 2.00 cents from Wednesday's close at $4.320 an ounce.

NYMEX October platinum was called to open off $1.00 to $2.00 an ounce from the previous close at $381.10, while NYMEX September palladium seen down $1.00 to $2.00 also from Wednesday's close at $154.75.
